# orz-mdhtml

A **self-contained** `.md.html` — a document that is quietly editable. Math like $e^{i\pi}+1=0$ renders inline.

## Features

1. Reads like a normal page
2. Click the pencil to edit
3. Live preview, theme switching

> "The best interface is no interface" — until you need one.

| Feature | Status |
|:--------|:------:|
| Preview | ✅ |
| Edit    | ✅ |
| Themes  | ✅ |

    return f"Hello, {name}!"
